task_commit_basis: merge commit of the reference change (code after the optimization landed), from https://github.com/facebook/zstd/commit/f6ef14329f396eb8b2c1290790e7547d070d9511

reference_change.title: "Short cache" optimization for level 1-4 DMS (+5-30% compression speed)

workload.source: written here from the title of https://github.com/facebook/zstd/pull/3152 (the short cache for dictionary match states at levels 1 to 4): a C program that compresses 160,000 blocks of 4 KiB at level 1 against a digested 64 KiB dictionary attached by reference (ZSTD_c_forceAttachDict), eval/tasks/workloads/facebook-zstd-pr3152-landed/eval_cdict.c, copied into the tree and linked against lib/libzstd.a, run on the tree where the change is already in

oracle.source: zstd's own fuzzer (tests/fuzzer.c, built by make -C tests fuzzer), 60 tests from seed 1; the fuzzer covers the compression paths the pull request changes

evidence.note: description, as matched by the miner: speedup claims: 2x; 1.5x

status_reason: built here and ran workload and oracle on the task and reference trees; see runs. Needs a C compiler named cc on the PATH and make (tested with Apple clang 17.0.0 on arm64 macOS)
